repository_scope.note: An earlier revision of the master specification directed an application analysis for a second first-party repository. The revised specification makes this repository the sole first-party scope. That analysis was removed and replaced by 12-agent-build-and-deployment-applications.md, and every artifact was swept of out-of-scope referents. See rescope_record below.

rescope_record.what_happened: Section 23 of the earlier specification revision directed an application analysis for a second first-party repository, which lane AUD-L6b performed read-only and wrote to a separate document (since deleted).
rescope_record.action_taken: That artifact was deleted. A replacement scoped solely to this repository was written as 12-agent-build-and-deployment-applications.md (lane AUD-L6c). All markdown, JSON, and JSONL evidence was swept of out-of-scope referents; per-record fields impact_dime and dime_relevance were renamed to impact_agent_platform and agent_platform_relevance, and values naming the out-of-scope repository were rewritten. Records carry a `rescoped` note where their text changed.
rescope_record.no_data_destroyed: No finding, severity, evidence label, or Ruflo-facing analysis was altered by the re-scope. Only the out-of-scope referent was removed.
rescope_record.collateral_repaired: Two sweep over-reaches were caught and repaired: Ruflo's own IPFS gateway hostname cloudflare-ipfs.com, and the ordinary English word 'notion'. Both are Ruflo evidence, not out-of-scope references.

findings_removed_as_out_of_scope.reason: These four lane AUD-L6b findings measured the OUT-OF-SCOPE repository itself (its file counts, its CI workflow coverage, its domain-specific capability gaps, and its plugin configuration) rather than Ruflo's behaviour. Under the sole-first-party-repository directive they are not audit evidence about Ruflo and were removed rather than rewritten.
findings_removed_as_out_of_scope.retention_reason: These four are facts about RUFLO discovered in that lane — unconditional `gh pr merge`, `gh workflow run`/`gh run cancel`, a fabricated {success:true, action:'merged'} when `gh` is absent, and helper scripts defaulting AUTO_PUSH=true — and remain valid Ruflo evidence independent of any host repository.
